scope: Public website claims that must stay aligned with verified application behavior

claims.desktop_data_boundary: Ordinary desktop financial data remains in the local application database.
claims.gmail_access: The desktop Gmail integration can view messages and mailbox settings and does not request send, edit, or delete access.
claims.hosted_ai: Bring-your-own cloud AI is optional, separately consented, redacted, and still processed under the selected provider's retention terms.
claims.hosted_credits: GODFIN does not currently operate or sell a hosted AI credit service.
claims.analytics: Consent-gated Google Analytics can receive website usage and device context; it is not described as anonymous.
claims.downloads: No signed public installer is claimed until a verified release URL, signature, and checksum are configured.
claims.commerce: Checkout stays closed until verified support and privacy contacts are configured.

required_privacy_disclosures: does not make the prompt anonymous
